title: 第19章 重回公司契约第20章 签订契约规则完善
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
“嘿，没想到，你还挺厉害的嘛！”
李笑笑看着恢复正常的电梯，又低头看向怀中的小女孩，不禁笑着开口。
看小女孩在面对前台的时候那么畏惧，还以为她很弱呢。
“嘻嘻，我和姐姐玩…”
得到了李笑笑的夸奖，小女孩不禁嘻嘻笑了起来。
只不过，她也并没有太多的话。
翻来覆去，都不过是那几句相似的话。
随后，电梯再没有任何变化，李笑笑两人一路来到了四十四层。
“叮！”
伴随着叮的一声，电梯门打开，李笑笑抱着小女孩大步走出。
辨认了一下方向，李笑笑迅速的向着公司走去。
公司依旧空空荡荡的，经理办公室的大门紧闭，百叶窗上，也没有了两个偷偷观察的眼睛。
在公司转了一圈，与她印象中一模一样，似乎就是她所工作的公司。
不过，李笑笑在一阵思索之后，就慢慢发现了不对的地方。
那就是这间公司，与她印象中的公司太像了，可以说是一模一样。
而事实上，哪怕再熟悉的地方，也必然会有不在记忆中的陌生之处。
更何况，是本就不是多么喜欢的公司了，她不可能将每一处细节完全记下。
除非，这间公司就是按照她的记忆复刻。
所以说，这里真就是她的梦境吗？
可是，做梦不该拥有如此清晰的意识才对啊。

做梦的时候，一旦清醒过来，意识到自己正在做梦，往往很快就会苏醒。
而现在，她敢保证，她的意识很清醒。
但是，她却丝毫也没有苏醒过来的迹象。
李笑笑转头，看向经理办公室的大门。
想到昨日的梦境，似乎最初的变化，就是从经理走出来，又返回经理办公室之后，然后从经理办公室开始的。
而且她先前离开公司的时候，似乎有人在经理办公室的百叶窗后面看着她。
那么是不是说，这一切的源头，就是经理办公室，或者说是就在经理办公室之中。
“咕咚！”
看着经理办公室的大门，李笑笑的眼神闪烁，暗暗吞咽了口唾沫，仿佛那是吞噬一切的无底深渊，是世上最恐怖的地狱。
不过最终，她还是猛的用力抱了抱怀中小女孩，一步步走向经理办公室大门。
“别…别进去…”
小女孩趴到李笑笑的耳畔，轻轻的低语，身体抖个不停，似乎恐惧到了极点。
李笑笑闻言不禁脚步一顿。
不过最终，她还是再次抬起脚，走向了经理办公室。
来都来了，怎么也要进去看看。
“咔哒！”
经理办公室的大门，被她轻松打开。
映入她眼帘的，正是他熟悉的经理办公室。
只是坐在经理办公室后面的，并不是她所熟悉的经理。
content_en:
"Hey, I didn't expect you to be pretty awesome!"
Li Xiaoxiao looked at the elevator that had returned to normal, then looked down at the little girl in his arms, and couldn't help but smile.
Seeing how scared the little girl was when facing the front desk, I thought she was weak.
"Hehe, I'm playing with my sister..."
After receiving Li Xiaoxiao's compliment, the little girl couldn't help but giggle.
However, she didn't say much.
Over and over again, it's just the same few words.
Afterwards, there was no change in the elevator, and Li Xiaoxiao and the two arrived at the forty-fourth floor.
"Ding!"
With a ding, the elevator door opened, and Li Xiaoxiao strode out holding the little girl in his arms.
After identifying the direction, Li Xiaoxiao quickly walked towards the company.
The company is still empty, the door to the manager's office is closed, and there are no two secretly observing eyes on the blinds.
After walking around the company, it looked exactly like what she remembered. It seemed to be the company where she worked.
However, after thinking for a while, Li Xiaoxiao slowly discovered something was wrong.
That was this company. It was so similar to the company in her memory that it could be said that it was exactly the same.
In fact, no matter how familiar a place is, there are bound to be strange places that are not in memory.
What's more, it's a company she doesn't really like, so it's impossible for her to write down every detail.
Unless, this company is replicating it according to her memory.
So, is this really her dream?
However, one should not have such a clear consciousness when dreaming.
When dreaming, once you wake up and realize that you are dreaming, you will often wake up soon.
But now, she can guarantee that her consciousness is clear.
However, she showed no sign of waking up.
Li Xiaoxiao turned his head and looked at the door of the manager's office.
Thinking about yesterday's dream, it seems that the first change started after the manager walked out, returned to the manager's office, and then started from the manager's office.
And when she left the company earlier, someone seemed to be watching her from behind the blinds in the manager's office.
So does it mean that the source of all this is the manager's office, or is it in the manager's office?
"Gudong!"
Looking at the door of the manager's office, Li Xiaoxiao's eyes flickered and he swallowed secretly, as if it was a bottomless abyss that swallowed everything and was the most terrifying hell in the world.
But in the end, she hugged the little girl in her arms fiercely and walked towards the door of the manager's office step by step.
"Don't...don't go in..."
The little girl lay next to Li Xiaoxiao's ear and whispered softly. Her body was shaking, as if she was extremely frightened.
Li Xiaoxiao couldn't help but pause when he heard this.
But in the end, she raised her feet again and walked to the manager's office.
Even though you are here, you still have to go in and take a look.
"Click!"
The door to the manager's office was opened easily by her.
What caught her eye was his familiar manager's office.
But the person sitting behind the manager's office was not the manager she was familiar with.
